query.text: 请看着我用盲杖走路，有障碍物或危险请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch me walk with my white cane, and warn me in time if there are any obstacles or dangers.

annotation.text_zh: 前方有积水和地滑警示牌，请注意避让。
annotation.text_en: Puddle and wet floor sign ahead, please watch your step.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
